name: hb
description: Part of the BOP (Benchmark for 6D object pose estimation) dataset collection: a vision dataset of RGB (and often depth) images with annotated 6D object poses designed to evaluate object detection and pose estimation under clutter and occlusion. It measures accuracy and robustness of 6D pose estimation algorithms across varying viewpoints, lighting, and occlusion.
evaluation_method: 6D pose error metrics (e.g., ADD, ADD-S, VSD) and recall under pose-error thresholds (BOP-style average recall)
general_score_metric: average recall under pose-error thresholds (BOP average recall) or per-metric recall (VSD/ADD-S)
typical_sota_score: varies by object and metric; recall scores often range from ~50% to >90% depending on difficulty and threshold
reputation: Part of the established BOP benchmark suite widely used in 6D object pose estimation research and evaluations.
